title: The Asset of Tashkent
author: Elodie Nakamura
blurb: Sable Galloway, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
